name: Chirality Tile
definition: One intrinsic tile position carrying occupancy and, if occupied, local chromatic/energy-density state plus relations.

name: Chirality Seed
definition: Four chirality tiles arranged as TL,TR,BL,BR.

name: Chirality Byte/Bite
definition: Three-dimensional set lift of a seed; displayed as two seed layers.
notes: Exact set-lift rule and spelling remain open.

name: Chirality Block
definition: Native three-dimensional domain with 64 tile positions; current toy profile half occupied.
notes: Not canonically an array/tree of bytes.

name: Chirality Fabric
definition: Larger recursive organization of chirality blocks/domains.

name: Genesis Field
definition: Sandbox/domain in which chirality structures are admitted and probed.

name: Time-Space
definition: Upstream organizational object; distinct from downstream spacetime.

name: spacetime
definition: Downstream realization after Helicon, Graviton, and Time-Shell handoff.

name: Resolution
definition: Determines which distinctions/readouts are available.

name: Bandwidth
definition: Determines which transformations/lifts/generators are available.
notes: Not canonically a count of two colors.

name: Persistence
definition: Identity recoverable through admissible continuation.

name: History
definition: Retained ordered structural provenance; does not require clock time.
notes: Winding is one component, not all History.

name: Chirality Space
definition: Smooth admissibility space Omega for chirality organization.

name: Local Time Shell
definition: Locally persistent organizational domain carrying localized temporal ordering from T5 onward.
notes: Each shell can carry local chirality update sequencing.

name: Six-Color Domain
definition: R,O,Y,G,B,V available on occupied tiles.

name: Resolved Local Color Charge
definition: Truncated-mean resolved color at tile/seed/byte/block domain scales.
notes: Telemetry/readout role active; deeper state role open.

name: Local Energy Density
definition: Energy density associated with occupied chirality state; colors investigated as basin/readout.

name: Native Energy
definition: Minimum admissible persistence difference.
notes: Originally discovered by QMO closure from unit strength + energy density.

name: Local Seed Torus
definition: Product of two cyclic color coordinates for the two occupied seed tiles.

name: Geometric Adjacency
definition: Time-independent native chirality update/possibility relation.
notes: Raw adjacency alone is commutative under fixed transfer.

name: Relationship
definition: Relationship propagates first; motion is a readout.

name: Connection / Lift Selector
definition: Selects a horizontal/operative transport from Bandwidth-filtered candidates or retains residual multiplicity.

name: Watcher
definition: Applies ancestry, chirality, residue, typing, Bandwidth/environment/History, and minimal-extra-structure checks.

name: Recursive Closure
definition: Idempotent closure recovery on recursive continuity states.

name: Domain Generator Map
definition: Maps closed domain geometry, environmental admissibility, and Bandwidth to available generators.

name: Helicon/Time-Shell to Q Handoff
definition: Source-respecting construction from Helicon/Time-Shell sector into canonical local Q field object.

name: QCD Comparison Target
definition: Non-Abelian SU(3) gauge-theory structure used only after native chirality algebra is derived.
